comments.author: maschine
comments.body_html:
Thanks for the detailed report - you found a real one. CraftQueue forced a full profile save every time the queue advanced a craft, and on a large modded profile that serialization takes seconds and blocked the server; the web request errors you saw were just the client’s polls timing out against it.

Fixed in v1.2.1: those saves now run in the background (and get coalesced), so starting/collecting a craft no longer stalls the server. If you still see a spike, the log now prints the exact save duration - that line would tell us whether the profile size itself is the remaining bottleneck.

comments.author: maschine
comments.body_html: Yeah, you’re right - I’ve added that to the description now. Also, you can now change the port in config.json.
